facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Mole walked by the river. He saw someone waving. It was a kind animal called Rat. He met Rat.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Mole was walking along the beautiful riverbank. He heard the sound of water flowing gently. Suddenly, a friendly animal waved from across the river. He met Rat, who was sitting on a small boat. Rat rowed his boat over and smiled at Mole. It was the beginning of a wonderful friendship.
facts.Word cards: river = 강 / beautiful = 아름다운 / sunlight = 햇빛 / sparkled = 반짝였다
